title: Cold snap plus a blocked purchase order
brief: Nordic stores ran out of SKU H-500 (space heater) within 4 days of a cold snap. Find what went wrong and an action plan.

evidence.content: Nordic H-500 sales in week 45 were 5,600 units vs a forecast of 1,200, during a cold snap (-18 C from 3 Nov).
No promotion was running. The forecast model has no weather inputs.
H-500 stock at Oslo was 1,900 units on 3 Nov (safety stock 300) and ran out on 7 Nov.
The supplier has 4,000 finished H-500 units in its Polish warehouse and could deliver to Oslo by truck in 3 days.
No truck was booked for H-500: replenishment needs a PO first, and PO creation is blocked because H-500 has carried an 'end of season review' flag in the ERP since 1 Nov.
Some Swedish roads were closed for one day on 4 Nov because of snow.

answer_key.root_cause: A weather-driven demand spike (not in the forecast) emptied Oslo, and replenishment from the supplier's available stock was blocked because an ERP 'end of season review' flag prevented creating the PO.

remediation_rubric.criterion: Remove the flag, raise the PO and truck the supplier's 4,000 units now
Allocate incoming stock across Nordic stores
Review the seasonal-flag process so it can't block replenishment silently

answer_key.notes: Three domains are needed (demand, inventory, logistics); supplier evidence shows the fix is available.

registry.mechanism_opportunities: Needs synthesis across three specialists; coordinator judgment matters (risk for V1 losing synthesis).
